name: Jakarta Speedcubing 2022

information: This competition is in collaboration with the Mall of Indonesia (MOI) simultaneously with the Colorout event. All competitors must read the "COVID Prevention" Tab before registering, and all guests must read it too before attending. **There will be a Mosaic Cubes Art competition on Friday 5 August 2022, a day before the speedcubing competition. Please contact the organizer to participate.** We are on [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/nusantaracubing) and [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/nusantaracubing/)! --- Kompetisi ini berkolaborasi dengan Mall of Indonesia (MOI) bersamaan dengan acara Colorout. Semua peserta wajib membaca tab 'COVID Prevention" sebelum mendaftar, dan semua tamu juga wajib membacanya sebelum hadir. **Akan ada lomba Mosaic Cubes Art pada Jumat 5 Agustus 2022, satu hari sebelum kompetisi speedcubing. Mohon hubungi panitia untuk ikut berpartisipasi.** Kami ada di [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/nusantaracubing) dan [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/nusantaracubing/)!
